versions.content: The number of cores that can be controlled by the AUTOSAR OS shall be configured offline. A new configuration item ( OsNumberOfCores ) within the OsOS container is used to specify the maximum number of cores that are controlled by the AUTOSAR OS. If no value for OsNumberOfCores has been specified the number of cores shall be one.
